name: Lantern
description:
Lantern agents are your AI-powered teammates, working 24/7 to optimize your brand's presence across all marketing channels. The agents are fully autonomous and incredibly capable teammates, intergrating with your existing apps and ready to go in minutes.


Connect your Lantern account to review the brands, projects, research, and marketing context you already have permission to access. Ask Claude to summarize how a brand appears across AI search experiences, identify citation opportunities, review positioning, inspect the latest marketing brief, or find relevant project work.

Lantern helps marketing teams move from fragmented reports to clear, grounded decisions. Claude can combine Lantern's current visibility data, brand context, citation opportunities, and project information into concise analysis that fits the question at hand. Use it to prepare a planning session, assess a brand's representation in AI search, identify content or authority gaps, review strategic context, or locate approved direction before beginning new work.


Lantern is designed for marketing teams, agencies, and brand leaders who need a reliable view of their representation across AI search and the work required to improve it. Connect once, then ask Claude focused questions about the Lantern intelligence already available to your team.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Lantern to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Lantern to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.asklantern.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Lantern MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Lantern provides these MCP tools: get_ai_visibility, get_brand_overview, get_citation_opportunities, get_marketing_brief, get_project_content, list_brands, and search_projects.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Lantern?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Lantern in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Lantern requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Lantern is developed by Lantern. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
